title: Juicy Spicy Croatian Chestnuts Casserole
description: A spicy and gooey Croatian dish featuring chestnuts, perfect for a romantic evening, with no onions or garlic.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the chestnuts and remove any shells or debris.
In a large bowl, toss the chestnuts with smoked paprika, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the chestnuts, cooking until they are lightly browned.
In a separate saucepan, bring the chicken broth to a boil and then reduce the heat to low.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of chestnuts.
Pour some of the chicken broth over the chestnuts, followed by a sprinkle of gruyere cheese.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Drizzle the heavy cream over the top layer of cheese.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
